scenario_type: Normalized source-matched engineering case, NOT Microsoft company total or forecast
comparison: Same delivered annualized virtual-core service in air-cooled baseline versus source-model cold-plate design, using 2021 US average grid in both cases
commercial_technology: Direct-to-chip cold plates and coolant distribution equipment; eligible implementation only

carbon_case.normalization_basis: Per 1000 tCO2e of baseline cradle-to-grave emissions in a validated source-matched cohort; denominator chosen for readability, not observed corporate cohort
carbon_case.damage_status: Monetized estimate under selected externality value factor, not observed damage or cash revenue

water_case.normalization_basis: Separate per 1000 m3 baseline life-cycle blue-water consumption normalization for source-matched cohort. NOT asserting this is the water consumed by the carbon case cohort.
water_case.reason_not_monetized: Need location-resolved life-cycle water inventory and corresponding water value factors; Microsoft total on-site consumption is an incompatible denominator

energy_case.normalization_basis: Separate per 1000 MJ nonrenewable primary energy normalization; not measured electricity

deployment_by_2031.formula_if_measured: G * 0.15 tCO2e; G * 38.268 USD2024, where G is source-matched baseline lifecycle emissions of only the cohort converted by2031
deployment_by_2031.interpretation: 100% design adoption within this defined unit case does not mean 100% fleet adoption; eligible refresh inventory absent. Do not multiply lifecycle-annualized results by years without explicit time profile.

fund_additionality.reason: Existing installations/commitments must be excluded; financing-caused extra eligible adoption and repayment contracts absent
fund_additionality.rule: Avoided externality dollars are not revenues. No principal guarantee.

key_assumptions: 15-year datacenter and six-year servers in source model
Cold-plate model includes 20% overclocking, 28% more virtual cores and 3% lower PUE
Equivalent service/SLA and workload must be independently verified; not an AI GPU universal factor
LCA includes materials, operations and end-of-life; Scope 2-only or corporate Scope 1-3 denominator cannot substitute
Zero-evaporation heat rejection is a separate case that may increase electrical demand

sources.inspection: Article Figure4 normalized to100; p337 1kgCO2e/core example explicitly hypothetical, not absolute baseline.

pitch: A Microsoft-authored, peer-reviewed design study supports a 15% climate-impact gap for matched air-cooled compute service using available cold-plate technology: 150 tonnes and $38,268 in modeled climate damage per1000 baseline lifecycle tonnes. The same design comparison reduces life-cycle blue water31%. These are engineering opportunity rates; the Microsoft-wide deployable denominator and investor-additional opportunity remain unmeasured.
